import importlib.util
spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('taskprog', program_file)
mod=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec); spec.loader.exec_module(mod)
def make(h,w,block,marks):
    g=[[0]*w for _ in range(h)]
    (r0,r1,c0,c1)=block
    for r in range(r0,r1+1):
        for c in range(c0,c1+1): g[r][c]=2
    for r,c,v in marks: g[r][c]=v
    return g
def expected(h,w,twos,marks):
    g=[[0]*w for _ in range(h)]
    for r,c in twos: g[r][c]=2
    for r,c,v in marks: g[r][c]=v
    return g
# Demo 1 input
m1=[(1,21,8),(2,19,8),(4,15,8),(7,18,8),(12,3,8),(13,9,8),(15,5,8),(17,8,8)]
i1=make(21,25,(1,8,2,9),m1)
# Expected demo 1 2-cells listed by row from output
rows1={0:list(range(2,10)),1:list(range(0,10)),2:list(range(0,10)),3:list(range(25)),4:list(range(0,10)),5:list(range(25)),6:list(range(25)),7:list(range(0,10)),8:list(range(25))}
for r in range(9,21): rows1[r]=[2,4,6,7]
e1=expected(21,25,[(r,c) for r,cs in rows1.items() for c in cs],m1)
# Demo 2
m2=[(1,4,3),(1,8,3),(3,6,3),(5,12,3),(7,1,3),(8,13,3),(13,8,3),(16,5,3)]
i2=make(20,15,(5,9,4,8),m2)
rows2={r:[5,7] for r in range(5)}
rows2[5]=list(range(0,9)); rows2[6]=list(range(15)); rows2[7]=list(range(4,15)); rows2[8]=list(range(0,9)); rows2[9]=list(range(15))
for r in range(10,20): rows2[r]=[4,6,7]
e2=expected(20,15,[(r,c) for r,cs in rows2.items() for c in cs],m2)
pred1=mod.transform(i1); pred2=mod.transform(i2)
print('demo1',pred1==e1,'demo2',pred2==e2)
if pred1!=e1:
 print([(r,c,pred1[r][c],e1[r][c]) for r in range(21) for c in range(25) if pred1[r][c]!=e1[r][c]][:20])
if pred2!=e2:
 print([(r,c,pred2[r][c],e2[r][c]) for r in range(20) for c in range(15) if pred2[r][c]!=e2[r][c]][:20])
